## Provider changes

Adding or updating a provider? Use the [data-only intake process](../provider-submissions/README.md) and [provider template](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/provider.md). Change only `provider-submissions/<id>.json`. Maintainer adapter wiring belongs in a separate PR. Sponsorship and paid featuring use the sponsorship inquiry, not this technical submission.

Do not include credentials, private account data, generated build output, or unrelated snapshot changes.
